lines.text: Jeremiah is to speak a word of tears, describing those slain by the sword in the country and those ravaged by famine in the city.
The people confess their sin, ask the LORD to remember His covenant, and put their hope in Him for rain.
The LORD says that even if Moses and Elijah stood before Him, He would not pity this people.
The LORD appoints four kinds of destroyers and makes the people a horror because of what Ahaz son of Hezekiah did in Jerusalem.
Because Jerusalem has forsaken Him, the LORD will destroy her people, make widows more numerous than the sand of the sea, and put the rest to the sword.
